limitations: Development verification only; official evaluation has not run.
No synthesis or board verification performed.
justified_rtl_changes: Initial implementation uses a two-bit unsigned counter, positive-edge clock, positive-edge asynchronous reset to 01, training enable, and endpoint saturation. No RTL revisions.
justified_tb_changes: Initial independent transition-table oracle checks all four states and all training input combinations, both saturation endpoints, non-training holds, off-edge asynchronous reset, reset release, held-reset priority, and falling-edge stability. No testbench revisions.
interface_cycle_contract: Original ports preserved; state updates at rising clock edges or asynchronous reset assertion, with no added latency.
static_review: Single sequential driver, nonblocking updates, explicitly sized two-bit arithmetic; reset and saturation match original problem.
